verified-source promotion phase gated by812cf22. No returns have been read at amendment.
Preserve the earlier gate and blockers; do not relabel assumptions as verified inputs.

One primary configuration: unchanged CL/GC commercial HP pair,1MCL and1MGC, raw quote
anchored2ATR20 stop, Monday08:01OPEN→Friday13:01OPEN, independent stops, no reentry/target.
This is not the paper's34commodity portfolio. Frozen2018–22design first; no2023+unless
design passes. No feature/window/side/size optimization.

Assumptions: latest SAME-as-of annual Legacy report dated at least6calendar days before
Monday08:00 is assumed available. Never trade it Tuesday. Skip entire weeks intersecting
2018-12-22–2019-03-15 (shutdown/release recovery); any US federal holiday Monday–Friday
also skips the week, fixed BEFORE returns. This conservative date convention does not prove
original publication or vintage. Report skipped counts and all candidates. Treat annual data
as current revised snapshots. Carryforward reports maximum21days. Do not use NQ release
exports as verified CL/GC dates. Both CL raw names under067651 are assumed same market;
record alias assumption. Gold088691. Do not assert independent identity verification.

Use supplied continuous CL/GC prices as price proxies: all splice movements during holdings
remain in P&L. Do not delete spikes or fit a roll adjustment from returns. These are
conditional continuous-series returns, not authenticated tradable-contract or native-micro
history. MCL prelisting simulation is counterfactual. Report source/roll sensitivity unresolved.

Shared Grid24 for2017–22 grids; inspect duplicate/conflicting keys first, invalidate conflicting
OHLCV keys. No price forward/backward fill. Require actual scheduled entry/exitOPEN in both
legs; unknown weeks retained as unresolved, never zero. Observed-bar stop simulation assumes
missing intervals do not hide stop hits; report absent/invalid held-minute counts explicitly.
No inferred outcomes on unresolved endpoints. Shared grid.execute/_walk on flattened weekly
paths, next-bar entry and active entry-bar stop; replace terminal bar with itsOPEN for time
exit. No target; worse gap fill atOPEN. Stops rawquote anchored at2ATR20 (rounded towardentry).
Slippage charged separately one native tick per entry/exit, commission1.24RT:3.24per micro,
6.48pair. Stress2ticksper fill fixed, not selectable. Missing-path results conditional only.
ATR arithmetic20prior Mon–Fri observed cash sessions using8:01–13:30CL/8:21–12:30GC;
require endpoints and>=90% observed minute coverage; no holidays/zero-range repair.

Design gate: complete resolved-pair gross mean >=12.96USD (2xpairRTcost), net positive,

placebos and numeric book bench. If passes freeze selection before additional work: immediate

Metrics from shared metrics/resampling; all pair/leg/year ledgers retained. Economic trial
count:1new primary design plus1fixed execution stress (stress not a nomination), additional
to archived variants/trials. No t6/Huntv2 restart. No buys/accounts/live/other-branch writes.

"""PH01: registered CONDITIONAL design-only feasibility test, not verified native fills."""
import os
os.environ.setdefault('NUMBA_CACHE_DIR','analysis/outputs/codex_commodity_hp_exploratory/cache/numba')
from pathlib import Path
import csv,io,json,hashlib,zipfile,warnings
from types import SimpleNamespace
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pandas.tseries.holiday import USFederalHolidayCalendar
from grid24 import Grid24
from grid import execute
import metrics as M
from resampling import max_dd
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT=ROOT/'analysis/outputs/codex_commodity_hp_exploratory/run_v1'

def clean(v):
    if isinstance(v,dict): return {str(k):clean(x) for k,x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v,list): return [clean(x) for x in v]
    if isinstance(v,(np.integer,)): return int(v)
    if isinstance(v,(float,np.floating)): return float(v) if np.isfinite(v) else None
    return v

def tstat(x):
    x=np.asarray(x,float);return float(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(x))) if len(x)>2 and x.std(ddof=1)>0 else np.nan

def nw(x,lags=5):
    x=np.asarray(x,float);n=len(x)
    if n<3:return np.nan
    z=x-x.mean();v=np.dot(z,z)/n
    for k in range(1,min(lags,n-1)+1):v+=2*(1-k/(lags+1))*np.dot(z[k:],z[:-k])/n
    return float(x.mean()/np.sqrt(v/n)) if v>0 else np.nan

def cot():
    rows=[]; hashes={}
    for year in range(2017,2023):
        p=ROOT/f'data/cot/deacot{year}.zip';hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
            with z.open('annual.txt') as raw:
                rd=csv.reader(io.TextIOWrapper(raw,encoding='latin-1'));h=next(rd)
                assert h[11]=='Commercial Positions-Long (All)' and h[12]=='Commercial Positions-Short (All)'
                for line,r in enumerate(rd,2):
                    if r[3].strip() not in ['067651','088691']:continue
                    oi=int(r[7].strip());lo=int(r[11].strip());sh=int(r[12].strip())
                    if oi<=0:raise ValueError('Invalid OI')
                    rows.append(dict(symbol='CL' if r[3].strip()=='067651' else 'GC',asof=pd.Timestamp(r[2]),hp=(sh-lo)/oi,oi=oi,commercial_long=lo,commercial_short=sh,year=year,line=line))
    d=pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if d.duplicated(['symbol','asof']).any():raise ValueError('Duplicate COT keys need adjudication')
    d.to_csv(OUT/'selected_cot.csv',index=False)
    return d.pivot(index='asof',columns='symbol',values='hp').sort_index(),hashes

def load(symbol):
    folder=OUT/'cache'/symbol;folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    conflicts=[];audit=[]
    for year in range(2017,2023):
        src=ROOT/f'data/{symbol}_1min_{year}.csv'
        df=pd.read_csv(src)
        dup=df[df.duplicated(['date','time'],keep=False)]
        bad=[]
        for key,grp in dup.groupby(['date','time']):
            if len(grp.drop_duplicates())>1:bad.append(key)
        conflicts+=bad
        audit.append(dict(symbol=symbol,year=year,rows=len(df),duplicate_rows=len(dup),conflicting_keys=len(bad),sha256=hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
        # Cache contains only the preregistered design/warmup dates.
        df=df[df.date.between(20170101,20221231)]
        df.to_csv(folder/f'{symbol}_{year}.csv',index=False)
    g=Grid24(str(folder/f'{symbol}_*.csv'),night_pattern='')
    for date,time in conflicts:
        rr=np.flatnonzero(g.dates==date)
        if len(rr):
            j=int(time//100*60+time%100)
            for k in ('o','h','l','c','v'):getattr(g,k)[rr[0],j]=np.nan
    return g,audit

def atr(g,start,end):
    vals=[];last=None
    for i,dt in enumerate(pd.DatetimeIndex(g.ts)):
        if dt.dayofweek>4:continue
        sl=slice(start,end+1);c=g.c[i,sl]
        if not(np.isfinite(c[0]) and np.isfinite(c[-1]) and np.isfinite(c).mean()>=.9):continue
        hi=np.nanmax(g.h[i,sl]);lo=np.nanmin(g.l[i,sl]);close=c[-1]
        tr=hi-lo if last is None else max(hi-lo,abs(hi-last),abs(lo-last))
        vals.append((dt,tr));last=close
    s=pd.Series(dict(vals));return s.rolling(20,min_periods=20).mean()

def walk(symbol,g,mon,side,distance):
    pv,tick=(100,.01) if symbol=='CL' else (10,.1)
    start=pd.Timestamp(g.ts[0]);first=(mon-start).days;last=first+4
    if first<0 or last>=g.D:return None,'outside_price_coverage'
    arrays={k:getattr(g,k)[first:last+1].ravel().copy()[None,:] for k in ('o','h','l','c')}
    j0=481;end=4*1440+781
    if not(np.isfinite(arrays['o'][0,j0]) and np.isfinite(arrays['o'][0,end])):return None,'missing_scheduled_open'
    missing=int((~np.isfinite(arrays['o'][0,j0:end+1])).sum())
    # Terminal OPEN is a time-exit quote, not an entire future minute's OHLC.
    px=arrays['o'][0,end]
    for k in arrays:arrays[k][0,end]=px
    adapter=SimpleNamespace(**arrays,last_j=np.array([end]),ts=np.array([mon.to_datetime64()]))
    distance=np.floor(distance/tick+1e-8)*tick
    sig=pd.DataFrame([dict(day=0,dj=j0-1,side=side,stop=distance,target=np.inf,exit_j=end,qty=1)])
    t=execute(adapter,sig).iloc[0]
    gross=(t['exit']-t.entry)*side*pv
    return dict(week=str(mon.date()),symbol=symbol,side=int(side),entry=float(t.entry),exit=float(t['exit']),
                stop_points=float(distance),exit_kind=int(t.kind),exit_minute=int(t.j1),
                gross=float(gross),commission=1.24,slippage=2*tick*pv,net=float(gross-3.24),stress_net=float(gross-5.24),
                missing_expected_or_unknown_minutes=missing,conditional_observed_bar_execution=True),None

def main():
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    positions,hashes=cot();grids={};audit=[];atrs={}
    for s,a,b in [('CL',481,810),('GC',501,750)]:
        grids[s],info=load(s);audit+=info;atrs[s]=atr(grids[s],a,b)
    hol=USFederalHolidayCalendar().holidays('2018-01-01','2022-12-31')
    events=[];ledgers=[]
    for mon in pd.date_range('2018-01-01','2022-12-31',freq='W-MON'):
        e=dict(week=str(mon.date()),status=None)
        dates=pd.date_range(mon,mon+pd.Timedelta(days=4))
        if dates.isin(hol).any():e['status']='fixed_holiday_week_exclusion'
        elif mon<=pd.Timestamp('2019-03-15') and mon+pd.Timedelta(days=4)>=pd.Timestamp('2018-12-22'):e['status']='fixed_shutdown_recovery_exclusion'
        else:
            candidates=positions.loc[(positions.index<=mon-pd.Timedelta(days=6)) & (positions.index>=mon-pd.Timedelta(days=21))].dropna()
            if candidates.empty:e['status']='unknown_report'
            else:
                row=candidates.iloc[-1];asof=candidates.index[-1]
                delta=row.CL-row.GC;side=int(np.sign(delta));e.update(asof=str(asof.date()),CL_hp=row.CL,GC_hp=row.GC,CL_side=side)
                if side==0:e['status']='tie_flat'
                else:
                    legs=[];error=None
                    for s,sgn in [('CL',side),('GC',-side)]:
                        prior=atrs[s].loc[atrs[s].index<mon]
                        if prior.empty or not np.isfinite(prior.iloc[-1]):error='missing_prior_atr';break
                        leg,err=walk(s,grids[s],mon,sgn,2*prior.iloc[-1])
                        if err:error=err;break
                        legs.append(leg)
                    if error:e['status']='unknown_'+error
                    else:
                        e.update(status='resolved_conditional',gross=sum(x['gross'] for x in legs),net=sum(x['net'] for x in legs),stress_net=sum(x['stress_net'] for x in legs))
                        ledgers+=legs
        events.append(e)
    ev=pd.DataFrame(events);tr=pd.DataFrame(ledgers);ev.to_csv(OUT/'all_weeks.csv',index=False);tr.to_csv(OUT/'trades.csv',index=False)
    known=ev[ev.status=='resolved_conditional'].copy();known['date']=pd.to_datetime(known.week)+pd.Timedelta(days=4)
    daily=pd.Series(0.,index=pd.bdate_range('2018-01-01','2022-12-31'))
    daily.loc[known.date]=known.net.to_numpy()
    unknown=ev[ev.status.str.startswith('unknown')]
    for d in pd.to_datetime(unknown.week)+pd.Timedelta(days=4):
        if d in daily.index:daily.loc[d]=np.nan
    daily.to_csv(OUT/'conditional_exit_booked_daily.csv',header=['net'])
    summaries={}
    for label,subset in [('design',known)]+[(str(y),known[pd.to_datetime(known.week).dt.year==y]) for y in range(2018,2023)]:
        x=subset.net.to_numpy();summaries[label]=dict(pair_weeks=len(x),gross=float(subset.gross.sum()),net=float(x.sum()),pair_week_t=tstat(x),pair_week_NW5=nw(x),stress_net=float(subset.stress_net.sum()),closed_week_DD=float(max_dd(x)))
    legs=tr.groupby('symbol').agg(trades=('net','size'),gross=('gross','sum'),net=('net','sum'))
    sides=tr.groupby(['symbol','side']).agg(trades=('net','size'),net=('net','sum'));legs.to_csv(OUT/'by_leg.csv');sides.to_csv(OUT/'by_side.csv')
    known_daily=daily.dropna()
    gate=dict(gross_mean_ge_2x_cost=bool(known.gross.mean()>=12.96),positive_net=bool(known.net.sum()>0),pair_t_ge2=bool(tstat(known.net)>=2),four_positive_years=bool(sum(summaries[str(y)]['net']>0 for y in range(2018,2023))>=4),both_legs_positive=bool((legs.net>0).all()),no_unknown_weeks=bool(len(unknown)==0))
    result=dict(label='EXPLORATORY_CONDITIONAL_CONTINUOUS_PRICE_PROXY_NOT_VERIFIED_NATIVE',phase='2018-22 design only',preregistration='ba2b92a',summaries=summaries,status_counts=ev.status.value_counts().to_dict(),by_leg=legs.reset_index().to_dict('records'),gate=gate,design_pass=all(gate.values()),five_metrics=M.perf(known_daily,known.net),daily_NW5=nw(known_daily),daily_basis='exit-booked pair weeks; NOT intraday MTM or account risk',unknown_daily_cells=int(daily.isna().sum()),source_audit=audit,cot_hashes=hashes,held_absent_minutes=int(tr.missing_expected_or_unknown_minutes.sum()),limits=['COT availability/vintage assumed; shutdown buffer and holiday exclusions frozen','Raw continuous roll splices retained; not verified contract P&L','Missing observed bars may hide stops; maintenance/weekends included in missing count','Prelisting MCL counterfactual micro costing','No numeric personal book comparison or account improvement claimed'],new_primary_evaluations=1,fixed_stress_evaluations=1,historical_run=False)
    (OUT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(clean(result),indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(clean({k:result[k] for k in ['summaries','status_counts','by_leg','gate','design_pass','five_metrics','daily_NW5']}),indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter('ignore',RuntimeWarning);main()
